title: Zupee turns to AI as it exits the gaming business
script:
Zupee is exiting the gaming business entirely to pivot into artificial intelligence.
Moneycontrol reported that the casual gaming platform is shifting its core focus.
The company operated online skill-based board games like Ludo before making this change.
Zupee plans to develop new products using AI to address needs across India.
Management has not disclosed any further details about its planned businesses.
Would you drop your core product for artificial intelligence?
